description.narrative: Comoros, HIV, Ministry of Health and Social Protection of the Union of the Comoros (DNLS)This program has the following goals: End the AIDS epidemic in the Union of the Comoros by the year 2030. The objectives of this program are: Reduce new infections by 50% by 2019. Ensure that 90% of people living with HIV are on treatment by 2019
